name: fused_sigmoid_mul
description: fused_sigmoid_mul(attn_output, gate) -> out. attn_output has shape [N, H]. gate may either have the same [N, H] shape or have a three-dimensional [N, G, D] shape with G*D = H. Compute out = attn_output.float() * sigmoid(gate.reshape(N, H).float()) in fp32, then cast to attn_output.dtype, returning a newly allocated [N, H] tensor. The native kernel uses gate strides directly for the 3D case and a flat path for the 2D case. No input mutation. The exercised dtype is bfloat16, including the strided 3D gate layout.
